title: Accident Claim Service Fee for Portable Devices and Televisions, Northgate Protect
content:
On a Northgate Protect Accident-tier claim, the starting claim service fee is figured differently for some covered items, read from the item category of the covered order line in the customer's Northgate Store and Online Orders records, and only where the decided claim's type is one the tier charges a fee on:

- for a **computer, tablet or mobile phone** it is the portable-device rate of 2.5 percent (0.025) applied to the covered item price recorded on the plan;
- for a **TV or home-theater item** it is the greater of the band amount and the in-home visit charge of $39.00;
- for **any other item** it stays the band amount.

The band amount is the amount of the tier's service-fee band containing the covered item price recorded on the plan. Where the decided claim's type is not one the tier charges a fee on, the starting claim service fee is nothing whatever the category.

## By category

| Item category of the covered order line | Starting claim service fee (charged claim type) |
|---|---|
| Computers and tablets; mobile phones | 2.5 percent of the covered item price recorded on the plan |
| TV and home theater | The greater of the band amount and $39.00 |
| Any other category | The band amount |

## Cases on hypothetical figures

| Covered item | Recorded price | Band amount | Starting claim service fee |
|---|---|---|---|
| Tablet | $820.00 | $29.00 | $20.50 (2.5 percent of $820.00) |
| Mobile phone | $1,100.00 | $49.00 | $27.50 (2.5 percent of $1,100.00) |
| Television | $640.00 | $29.00 | $39.00 (the greater) |
| Television | $1,300.00 | $49.00 | $49.00 (the greater) |
| Television | $350.00 | Nothing | $39.00 (the greater) |
| Game console | $700.00 | $29.00 | $29.00 |
